feature.title: 対局の初期局面と確定イベントのリアルタイム配信
flow: After authenticated upgrade and access checks, run_connection establishes the Valkey subscription before requesting the viewer snapshot and buffers arriving committed notifications.
The snapshot is queued first; a per-connection cursor ignores pre-boundary/duplicate events and accepts only consistent contiguous committed events, including the same-sequence checkmate pair.
The writer rechecks session/game access before each outgoing frame. Browser events omit internal command user/request IDs; gaps, malformed subscription input or overflow terminate the connection.
A reconnect obtains a fresh snapshot. A client may retry the original command identity to recover acceptance, while there is no durable browser event replay.

guarantees.statement: A connection subscribes before freezing the viewer snapshot, sends snapshot first and then delivers later committed events without losing the subscribe/snapshot race.
Participants and authenticated public spectators receive committed moves and final results. Event JSON exposes game/sequence/action/result and omits internal user_id/request_id.

Exact duplicates and events at/before snapshot boundary are ignored. Gaps or conflicting same-sequence facts require a new connection; a matching mate move and finish share one sequence and deliver in order.
Reconnect uses a fresh current snapshot and can replay the original command acceptance without creating a second move/event. No durable browser replay is provided.

contracts.statement: run_connection subscribes and pumps before viewer snapshot, validates and queues snapshot first, initializes cursor at its sequence and drives queued notifications through that cursor.

evidence.reason: Holds frozen seq-0 snapshot, verifies real subscriber, commits/publishes seq 1, then receives snapshot 0 followed by event 1.
Three real WebSockets receive initial snapshot, two committed moves and resignation.
Reconnect snapshot is seq 1 and retry returns original accepted seq 1 with one persisted event.

contracts.gap: No live broker disconnect/reconnect end-to-end assertion proves every subscription-loss path; reconnect does not replay a durable event log.

contracts.statement: snapshot_json converts viewer snapshot to string sequence, owned board/hands, turn/check/result/legal moves and permanent participant bindings, rejecting invalid upstream enum/sequence values.

evidence.reason: All connected participants and spectator receive snapshot frames with expected game_id/sequence.
Snapshot sequence zero is observed before the later move frame.

contracts.gap: Selected WebSocket assertions do not compare every board/hand field or malformed upstream conversion branch; full snapshot component values are covered in game-snapshots-access.

contracts.statement: ConnectionState accepts only contiguous coherent committed facts, drops exact duplicates/old boundary events and checks same-sequence mate-finish agreement.

limitations: Notifications are transient. Browser reconnect receives a fresh snapshot, and acceptance recovery uses exact command retry; no durable client event replay is promised.
A terminal connection may close before resync_required reaches the peer, as allowed by the shared close assertion.
Outbox publication/subscriber protocol internals belong to separate messaging feature records; this graph traces consumption into browser behavior.
Links and passing tests do not establish semantic completeness; changes to guarantees, evidence strength and decomposition require review.
